title: Drumm's evaluation of the Biondi team's papers

tellings.quote: My original stance when I started looking at this back in 2020 when I was evaluating their original paper was about 50/50.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who studies the pyramids, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that he has been weighing papers by a team led by Filippo Biondi about the pyramids on Egypt's Giza plateau, including a second paper on the Khafre pyramid and work shown at a conference in Malta. Drumm says that when he first looked at their original paper in 2020, he thought it was about a 50/50 chance they were right. He tells it to show how his view of the team's claims has developed since.
